questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about the Emergency?
choices: It was declared in 1970 by Indira Gandhi.
It led to the suspension of all fundamental rights.
It was proclaimed due to the deteriorating economic conditions.
Many Opposition leaders were arrested during the emergency.
questions.solution: The correct statement is that many Opposition leaders were arrested during the Emergency. The other options are incorrect because the Emergency was declared in 1975, not 1970, and while it affected fundamental rights, it did not suspend all of them. The main reason for the Emergency was not economic conditions.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा आपातकाल के बारे में सही कथन है?
choices: इसे 1970 में इंदिरा गांधी द्वारा घोषित किया गया था।
इससे सभी मौलिक अधिकारों के निलंबन हुए।
इसकी घोषणा आर्थिक स्थिति में बिगड़े हुए कारणों के कारण की गई थी।
आपातकाल के दौरान कई विपक्षी नेताओं को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया था।
hi.solution: सही कथन यह है कि आपातकाल के दौरान कई विपक्षी नेताओं को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया था। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि आपातकाल 1975 में घोषित किया गया था, 1970 में नहीं, और यह मौलिक अधिकारों के निलंबन के कारण नहीं था। आपातकाल का मुख्य कारण आर्थिक स्थिति नहीं था।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate terminology as found in Indian history textbooks.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणता आपत्काल बद्दल खरा विधान आहे?
choices: तो 1970 मध्ये इंदिरा गांधी द्वारे घोषित करण्यात आला होता.
त्यामुळे सर्व मूलभूत अधिकार थांबवले गेले.
तो आर्थिक स्थितीच्या खालाबारीमुळे घोषित करण्यात आला होता.
आपत्काल दरम्यान अनेक विरोधी पक्षाचे नेते अटक करण्यात आले.
mr.solution: आपत्काल दरम्यान अनेक विरोधी पक्षाचे नेते अटक करण्यात आले हे खरे विधान आहे. इतर विकल्प खोटे आहेत कारण आपत्काल 1975 मध्ये घोषित करण्यात आला होता, 1970 मध्ये नव्हे, आणि त्यामुळे मूलभूत अधिकारांचा असर झाला होता, परंतु सर्व मूलभूत अधिकार थांबवले गेले नाहीत. आपत्कालचे मुख्य कारण आर्थिक स्थिती नव्हती.

questions.stem: What was the main reason for the Bihar movement in 1974?
choices: To support the Congress party
To protest against the Loknayak Bihar government
To protest against the Indira Gandhi government
To improve railway services
questions.solution: The main reason for the Bihar movement in 1974 was to protest against the Loknayak Bihar government, as it faced widespread criticism for corruption and mismanagement. The other options are incorrect because the movement was not about supporting any political party, nor was it focused on the Bhoodan movement or railway improvements.

hi.stem: 1974 में बिहार आंदोलन का मुख्य कारण क्या था?

लोकनायक बिहार सरकार के विरोध में
इंदिरा गांधी सरकार के विरोध में
रेलवे सेवाओं में सुधार करने के लिए
hi.solution: 1974 में बिहार आंदोलन का मुख्य कारण लोकनायक बिहार सरकार के विरोध में था, क्योंकि इस सरकार को भ्रष्टाचार और बर्बरता के लिए व्यापक आलोचना का सामना करना पड़ा। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि आंदोलन किसी राजनीतिक दल के समर्थन में नहीं था, न ही इसका लक्ष्य भूदान आंदोलन या रेलवे सुधारों पर केंद्रित था।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate terminology. The correct answer remains option (2) and the distractors are still incorrect.

लोकनायक बिहार सरकारविरुद्ध आंदोलन करणे

mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi terminology for political terms like 'Loknayak Bihar government' and 'Bhoodan movement'.

questions.stem: Why did the Railway employees in 1974 go on a strike?
choices: To protest against the government
To demand a bonus and better service conditions
To support the Bihar movement
To oppose the judiciary
questions.solution: The Railway employees in 1974 went on a strike to demand a bonus and better service conditions, which was a direct response to their workplace concerns. The other options are incorrect because there is no evidence to suggest the strike was primarily about protesting the government, supporting the Bihar movement, or opposing the judiciary.

hi.stem: 1974 में रेलवे कर्मचारी क्यों हड़ताल पर गए?

hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question and solution, with appropriate terminology used in a Hindi-medium educational context.

questions.stem: What issue did the Kesavananda Bharati Case address?
choices: The right to property
The power of Parliament to amend the Constitution
The role of the judiciary in politics
The rights of workers
questions.solution: The Kesavananda Bharati Case addressed the power of Parliament to amend the Constitution, as it established limits on how the Constitution could be altered. The other options are incorrect because the case did not concern the right to property, the role of the judiciary in politics, or the rights of workers.

hi.stem: केसवानंद भारती मामला किस मुद्दे को संबोधित करता है?

hi.critique: Translation accurately reflects the original meaning with appropriate Hindi legal terminology.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the main reason the Janata Party government under Morarji Desai lost its majority?
choices: It failed to implement a clear political programme
It was overthrown by a military coup
It was supported by the Congress party
It had too many leaders competing for power
questions.solution: The Janata Party government under Morarji Desai lost its majority because it failed to implement a clear political programme, leading to internal disarray and loss of public support. A military coup did not occur, the Congress party was not a supporter, and while leadership competition existed, it was a result of the lack of a unified programme.

hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English content, with appropriate terminology used in a Hindi-medium context.

questions.stem: What was the consequence of the Railway strike of 1974?

hi.stem: 1974 के रेल भूखंड आंदोलन का परिणाम क्या रहा?
choices: इसके कारण जनता पार्टी का गठन हुआ
